title: Short Rest in room 1.2
headline: An hour in room 1.2 with his back to the archway: two Hit Dice bring him back to 20/20 HP.

bullets.label: Hit Dice
bullets.text: 1d6+2 twice, 4 and 7 HP: 12 → 20/20 HP (the second die capped). One Hit Die left.

bullets.label: Arcane Recovery
bullets.text: kept. Only Magic Missile is lost; he saves the recovery for something bigger deeper in.

bullets.label: Light
bullets.text: the thrown torch burned out at 09:50; the lamp's flask runs to 14:10. Six torches left.
**Floors have no wanderers,** so the hour passes quietly.
